beats.headline: Ten minutes
beats.text: The Great Race was a replacement, thrown together at the last minute with the Valtay's money for a slot whose original floor had been scrapped: a sealed circuit of glass tunnels with pit-stop safe rooms at the nodes, hundreds of kilometres long. Donut arrives in a fish tank, ranked number one, and picks a new class alone because the chat is down. She takes Viper Queen, which spits poison. Prepotente arrives in the pole-position chamber he bought with hunter hands at the Masquerade. Borant throws everything it has at him (freeze, paralysis, an administrative hold, four gnolls with guns), and the AI negates every piece of it and makes Borant follow its own rules. His mother's boots carried a fairy tale in their description, about a boy trapped in a maze whose tunnels seal behind him, who spends years learning how to crack the walls. The Apothecary had sent Donut a hammer and a metal rod, each marked with a small seven. Minutes after the floor opens, Prepotente brings the whole circuit down into fine dust. No crawler runs the maze. No mob, NPC or boss is ever met on it. Mordecai spends the ten minutes the seventh floor exists as a slime with no arms. The only floor of the crawl that was never played goes straight to the eighth, and the audience that paid for it in advance gets no refund.
